correctness.rationale: Eliminating x^q=y-x² yields quartic X^4−2yX²+X+y²−y^q so all fibers have <=4 distinct roots. For each nonzero h=x-z the equal-image pair relation x+z=−h^(q−1) determines exactly one ordered pair, giving sum r(r-1)N_r=q²−1. Distinct triple preimages biject with ordered distinct norm-one αβγ=1 in cyclic U of order m=q+1, count m²−3m+2g. A triple fails to extend to fourth point precisely for an opposite α,β; there are 3(m−2g) such triples. Thus N3=(m−2g)/2, N4=(m²−6m+8g)/24; pair, mass and target identities yield all remaining N_r. The argument uses 2 invertible, valid for odd q including characteristic3. Independent exhaustive quadratic-coordinate evaluation verified every target multiplicity for 10 odd primes. Unrestricted proof is algebraic, not extrapolated from tests.
